g.text: Logical view - code (C4 level 4): the Booking aggregate (Dom/Bookings/Booking.cs)
+ForPlayer(pitchId, playerId, startsAt, endsAt, price, now, seriesId = null) : Booking
+ForCustomer(pitchId, customerName, customerPhone, startsAt, endsAt, price, now) : Booking
Every property has a private set; the constructor is private.
ForPlayer: playerId ≠ Guid.Empty; ForCustomer: name and phone
filled in (trimmed); both: EndsAt > StartsAt, Price > 0,
Status = Confirmed, Id = Guid.CreateVersion7(), UTC instants.
A method that returns a result changes the state only when
the result is the success one (Cancelled, Marked, true).
CancelByClub without a reason is a programming error (exception):
the service validates first. The cancellation window comes in
as an argument and is never stored in the booking.
Overlaps is half-open [start, end), like bookings_no_overlap.
